''1ˢᵗ – 3ʳᵈ'' - BelowNatural |difficulty = Easy |length_measurement = 00:51.04 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Forest Camp''' is a military base surrounded by hills. It was originally a simplistic map, but has now since been changed to become very detailed. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Forest Camp''' is a military base in a forest, surrounded by hill terrain. There is a large gate, which is the entrance to the military base. Around the map, there are multiple wooden houses, a green military tent, two wooden watch towers, a military exercise with tires, and a shooting range can be seen. A stone path can be seen, which connects multiple of the buildings. Around the map, multiple barrels, wooden crates, rocks and small grassy hills can be seen. The path starts and ends at a cave. The enemies will take multiple turns, avoiding various structures seen on the map. |Version 4 |The fourth version of '''Forest Camp''' was a military base island. Despite being an island, three sides of the map were surrounded by hilly terrain. Around the map, there were various miscellaneous military buildings, including hangers, administrative buildings and a headquarters. Despite the map's name, there were not too many trees around the map, given its general openness. On the hills, there was an outlook tower that had visual of the entire island and the sea. A road system connected the entire base, with tanks being visible around the map, as well as a paved runway on the only non-hilly part of the map. Next to the runway were several aviation hangers, planes and an air control tower. The path began at a cave in one of the hills. Initially, the path was grassy, then turned into a military exercise path, with tires being seen on the path. The path then entered the main road system of the island, which took a detour to avoid a tank blocking the road. It then ended at the military base headquarters, with a large vehicle entrance. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Forest Camp''' was exactly identical to the second version, except with terrain water surrounding the island. |Version 2 |In the second version of '''Forest Camp''', tall mountains surround most of the fortified island. Hangars, stone walls and outposts could be seen around the map. Alongside the structures were [[Humvee 3|Humvees]] and [[Tank (Unit)|Tanks]]. Many tall trees were dotted around the island. Two caves could be seen, though one was blocked off by a [[Humvee 3|Humvees]]. The brown pebble path began at the edge of the military outpost and ended at the far cave. The path twisted around several buildings and natural environment. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Forest Camp''' was a simplistic map that resembled a camping outpost, with a single watchtower in the middle of the map. There were very few trees around the path. There were some stone mountains scattered around the map, where you can place cliff towers on. The entire map was surrounded by a large green baseplate. The black path meandered through the "forest" taking two cutbacks. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:Forest CampV5}} |Version 4 |{{Map:Forest Camp}} |Version 1 |{{Map:Forest CampV1}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Easy|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *Ground tower should be placed around the middle path of the map. **The staging area of this map is very ideal for the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Pursuit]], due to its circular nature. *While there are a lot of cliff spots on this map, they are slightly to the side of the path, away from ideal ground placement. **The [[DJ Booth]] is ideal on this map as it will allow ranged units to reach across the entire map. *The map has plenty of straight paths, towers with pierce such as the [[Gatling Gun]], [[Shotgunner]] and [[Necromancer]] are quite useful as they can make good use out of this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} ForestCamp.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) Forest Camp New.png|Second and third versions (13 October 2019 – 8 May 2021) FC logo.png|Fourth version (8 May 2021 – 21 December 2022) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Forest.png|First version (14 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) FCView.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) FCV2.png|Third version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) FCView2.png|Fourth version (8 May 2021 – 21 December 2022) {{GalleryHeader|Top Down}} ForestCampTopDown.png|Fourth version (8 May 2021 – 21 December 2022) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail10.png|Current version on the game thumbnail. ForestCampDI.jpg|Fourth version on a development image. 9MapsDI.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *This map was remade after the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] with a mid-poly look, replacing the old blocky version, and adding much more detail to the map. **This map was further updated in the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]] and then later in the [[v1.6.0|Violent Night Update]] so that the map was more in line with the artistic style of the game. *In the second version of '''Forest Camp''', you could place ground towers under the water. *In the second and third versions of '''Forest Camp''', the decoration vehicles were the [[Humvee 3]] and [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] units that were present in the game at the time of the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], though the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] was khaki-colored instead of green. **In the fourth version of '''Forest Camp''', a slim Tank could be seen (though this was not any of the [[Military Base]]'s [[units]]) and the [[Ace Pilot]]'s Level 4 and 5 planes could also be seen next to the runway. *This map once appeared on the loading screen when entering a map. ==Update History== *'''14 June 2019''' -
